title: A Long-term Extension Study of Cleminorexton in Participants with Narcolepsy and Idiopathic Hypersomnia
official: A Long-term Extension Study of the Safety and Efficacy of Cleminorexton in Participants with Narcolepsy and Idiopathic Hypersomnia Who Completed a Sponsored Cleminorexton Clinical Trial
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety and tolerability of Cleminorexton
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. All Participants (returning and rollover): •	Participants with narcolepsy (NT1 or NT2) or IH who have completed the full treatment period in Study ORX750-0201, ORX750-004 or ORX750-202. Participants who participated in but did not complete ORX750-202 for non-safety related reasons, may be eligible with sponsor approval. • 18-71 years of age •	Participants must be able and willing to participate in all scheduled evaluations and procedures per protocol and must agree to be available to complete all study measurements and comply with study restrictions. •	Male and female participants must comply with contraception requirements described in the protocol. •	Is willing and able to discontinue/refrain from taking all medications used for the treatment of narcolepsy or idiopathic hypersomnia
2. Returning Participants Only: o	BMI ≥17.0 and ≤45 kg/m2
Exclusion criteria:
1. All Participant (returning and rollover): 1.	Use or planned use of any medications in the prohibited medications list (see Appendix 3 of Protocol).
2. 10.	For the full list of criteria please refer to Protocol
3. 2.	Travel across more than 3 time zones within 2 weeks before the Baseline Visit (Returning Participants only) or planned within 2 weeks before any visit containing an MWT.
4. 3.	Donated blood or plasma within 6 weeks before the Screening Visit, between the Screening Visit and Baseline Visit (Returning Participants only), or who plan to donate blood before the End of Treatment Visit (all participants).
5. 4.	Occupation requiring variable shift work or nightshift work within the past 6 months or planning at any time during the duration of the study.
6. 5.	Unable to refrain from ingesting specific products (refer to protocol) for 1 week prior to the first dose of study intervention and throughout the treatment period
7. 6.	Development of any new disease/disorder that, in the opinion of the investigator, would make the participant unable to continue the study.
8. 7.	The participant has a history of positive urine pregnancy test or is a pregnant or lactating/nursing female participant.
9. 8.	The participant has poor peripheral venous access in the opinion of the investigator.
10. 9.	The participant is judged by the investigator or the sponsor to be inappropriate for the study.
